ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Science and ICT and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Ordinance No. 1, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (8) Omitted.

(9) The Rules on International Money Orders shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4, Article 5 (1), and the former part of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, respectively, "Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning" shall be replaced with "Minister of Science and ICT."

(10) through <41> Omitted.
